scripts.commit: prettier --write . && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const has=fs.readdirSync('.changeset').some(f=>f.endsWith('.md')&&f.toLowerCase()!=='readme.md');cp.execSync(!process.stdin.isTTY&&has?'pnpm exec changeset status':'pnpm exec changeset',{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.ship: changeset version && pnpm run build && git add . && git commit -m "chore: release" && changeset tag && git push --follow-tags
